title: Embedding of the appended coordinates
statement: Let $r,a,K$ be nonnegative integers with $a\le K$. The embedding of tuples of length $r+a$ into tuples of length $r+K$ sends each appended coordinate $i<a$ to the appended coordinate with index $i$ after the first $r$ coordinates, viewed in the larger block of length $K$.
